parameters.name: AuthorizationId
parameters.description:
The ID of the project authorization to modify.
> You can call the ListProjectAuthorizations operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The new description of the project authorization.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The new name of the project authorization.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: ScopeType
parameters.description:
The scope of manageable assets associated with the authorization after modification. Valid values:

- **1**: All projects.

- **2**: Specified projects.
